text: Ships OpenCode and Claude Code as the default AI coding agent harnesses for programmers
quote: Omarchy ships with [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai/) and [Claude Code](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/overview) as the default agent harnesses for programmers.

text: Includes pre-wired, lazy-loaded launchers for every major coding-agent CLI
quote: Omarchy ships pre-wired lazy-loaded launchers for every major coding-agent CLI.

text: Shell aliases start OpenCode in the current directory (c) and Claude Code in danger mode (cx)
quote: invoke the `c` alias to start OpenCode within that directory. Claude Code ... can be started in danger mode using the `cx` alias.

text: On first boot, prompts you to set up a default AI agent, sign in, and put it to work on your computer
quote: On first boot, Omarchy invites you to set up a default agent. Pick your favorite, sign in, and put it to work on your computer.

text: Clicking an app-crash notification sends your agent to examine the crash dump, diagnose it, and help report the bug
quote: When an app crashes, click the notification to send your agent on the case. It can examine the crash dump, diagnose what went wrong, and help report the bug.

text: Ships agent skills so you can describe apps, plugins, or themes and have your agent build them
quote: Omarchy ships with skills to help your agent make apps, plugins, and themes. Describe what you want, try what it builds, and share it with everyone.

text: Thousands of community plugins are available, and you can have your agent build missing ones
quote: Thousands of community plugins are available for Omarchy. Don't find what you need? Just put your agent on the job, then share when done.

text: The system can be controlled through the omarchy CLI, which helps when an AI agent does customization or configuration
quote: you can also control it through the `omarchy` CLI. This is particularly helpful when you're having an AI agent work with you on customization or configuration.

text: Installs Rails, Laravel, Node.js, and many other dev environments from the menu, with Mise managing per-project language versions
quote: Install Ruby on Rails, Laravel, Node.js, and a long list of other development environments from the Omarchy menu. Mise handles language versions, so each project can use what it needs.

text: Neovim is the default editor, with VSCode, Cursor, Zed, Sublime, Helix, Vim, and Emacs installable and settable as the system default
quote: Neovim is the default, with VSCode, Cursor, Zed, Sublime Text, Helix, Vim, and Emacs ready to install. Pick your favorite and make it the system-wide default.

text: Theme matching is available for VSCode, Cursor, VSCodium, Helix, and Zed
quote: Theme matching is offered for `VSCode`, `Cursor`, `VSCodium`, `Helix`, and `Zed`.

text: Foot is the default terminal, with Alacritty, Ghostty, and Kitty integrated; switching keeps the same shortcuts
quote: Foot is the fast, lightweight default. Prefer Alacritty, Ghostty, or Kitty? All four are integrated, and switching your default keeps the same keyboard shortcuts working.

text: Includes Lazygit, a terminal-based Git UI alternative to GitHub Desktop
quote: Lazygit is a delightful alternative to something like the GitHub Desktop application, and it runs inside the terminal.

text: The fip command forwards ports from a remote host to localhost over SSH
quote: fip: Forward one or more ports from a remote host to localhost via SSH.

text: Fuzzy file finding with preview via the ff alias, using fzf
quote: Go to any directory, type `ff`, and you'll be able to fuzzy find your way to any file in that tree, while seeing a preview

text: Zoxide replaces cd and jumps to frequently visited directories from partial names
quote: Next time, you can just do `cd omarchy` (or even just `cd oma`), and Zoxide will take you directly there.

text: A hotkey starts a persistent Tmux session that you can resume later
quote: You start a new Tmux session in a fresh terminal using `Super + Alt + Return`, and because Tmux is a persistent process, you can resume your session

text: Everything in the system is operated via the keyboard
quote: Everything in Omarchy happens via the keyboard — EVERYTHING!

text: Keyboard hotkeys open the application launcher and the Omarchy Menu
quote: you can hit `Super + Space` to reveal the application launcher and `Super + Alt + Space` to open the Omarchy Menu.

text: Super + K shows all the main keyboard bindings
quote: You can see all the main keyboard bindings with `Super + K`.

text: Hotkeys toggle windows between tiling and floating, and switch between dwindle and scrolling layouts
quote: `Super + T` Toggle window between tiling/floating ... `Super + L` Toggle between dwindle and scrolling layout

text: Comes with nineteen built-in themes, selectable from the Omarchy Menu
quote: Omarchy comes with nineteen beautiful themes. You can select between them via Style > Theme in the Omarchy Menu

text: A theme restyles the whole system at once: terminal, bar, notifications, and wallpaper
quote: A theme restyles the whole system at once: terminal, bar, notifications, wallpaper.

text: A dedicated hotkey jumps straight to the theme selector
quote: hop directly to the theme selector using `Super + Ctrl + Shift + Space`.

text: More themes are available on an extra themes page, and you can make your own
quote: You can find even more themes on the extra themes page or even make your own theme.

text: The included Aether app creates new themes through a GUI for picking colors and searching backgrounds
quote: You can also use the included Aether application to create a new theme using a lovely GUI interface to play with colors and search for backgrounds.

text: Clipboard history for both text and images, opened with Super + Ctrl + V via Walker
quote: The clipboard history is provided by Walker and works for both text and images. You trigger it by Super + Ctrl + V

text: Unified clipboard hotkeys that work in almost every app
quote: Omarchy tackles both problems with unified clipboard hotkeys that work (almost) everywhere.

text: AI dictation via Voxtype: hold F9 or toggle with a hotkey, and text appears in the focused input
quote: Once installed, you dictate by holding down `F9` or by toggling with `Super + Ctrl + X`, and the dictated text will appear in the focused input area.

text: Countdown reminders with a message, set by hotkey or with the omarchy reminder CLI
quote: Omarchy has a built-in way to set simple reminders based on a countdown timer and with a message. You can do this via `Super + Ctrl + R`

text: Hotkey notices show date and time, battery status, and current weather
quote: You can quickly access the date and time, battery status, and current weather using the hotkey notices.

text: Select a screen region to extract its text using Tesseract OCR
quote: Hit `Super + Ctrl + PrtScr` to select a region on the screen for text extraction. The tesseract open source OCR model will then quickly convert that selection into text

text: Snapshots are created automatically on every update, and manual snapshots via omarchy-snapshot create
quote: We create snapshots automatically on every Omarchy update, but should you want to create your own, you can use omarchy-snapshot create.

text: Runs Windows in an isolated Docker VM with no access to other files on the system
quote: Omarchy offers an easy way to run Windows through a Docker VM. ... The VM does not have access to any other files on your system, so you're safe from malware or viruses on the Linux side.

text: The Windows VM uses hardware virtualization for near-native CPU performance, with a shared clipboard and a shared file folder
quote: Hardware virtualization brings near-native CPU performance for Office and everyday work, with a shared clipboard and a folder for moving files between Windows and Linux.

text: The omarchy windows key command retrieves the machine's original Windows Pro license key
quote: Run `omarchy windows key` to retrieve your machine's original key (this only works on Pro, not Home licenses).

text: Installs to a single partition alongside Windows or other OS installations
quote: In Omarchy Quattro, you're able to install Omarchy to a single partition alongside Windows or other installations.

text: Supports unattended installs
quote: The manual also covers [dual booting beside Windows](/manual/dual-boot-install/) and [unattended installs](/manual/unattended-installs/).

text: Write the ISO to a USB stick, answer five questions, and get a finished desktop
quote: Write the ISO to a USB stick and answer five questions. It hands back a finished desktop.

text: Can be tried out first by running all of Omarchy in a virtual machine
quote: All of Omarchy running in a virtual machine, so you can get a taste first.

text: Full-disk encryption is mandatory
quote: Full-disk encryption is mandatory ... Firewall is enabled by default: All incoming traffic by default except for port 22 for ssh and port 53317 for LocalSend.

text: Firewall is on by default, blocking incoming traffic except SSH and LocalSend ports
quote: Full-disk encryption is mandatory ... Firewall is enabled by default: All incoming traffic by default except for port 22 for ssh and port 53317 for LocalSend.

text: Ready for Steam and RetroArch, with graphics drivers (including NVIDIA) configured during installation
quote: Omarchy comes ready for Steam, RetroArch, and a whole world of gaming. Graphics drivers and configuration, including NVIDIA on supported hardware, are sorted during installation.

text: Runs on old hardware such as a 2011 ThinkPad X220 with 2GB of RAM
quote: Even a 2011 ThinkPad X220 with 2GB of RAM can run Omarchy, with room to spare.
